Members of the Health Alliance for Democracy hold a protest at the Department of Health in Manila on Monday, December 15, calling for the resignation of Health Secretary Dr. Teodoro J. Herbosa.

The group accused Herbosa of failing to protect public health and alleged corruption within the Department of Health, which they said mirrors the controversy surrounding the DPWH.

📷: Mark Balmores | MB
